reason: The operational verdict (no rule change; apply the 09:00Z / R37-A3 read rule verbatim) is right, but it is the existing default and needs no new finding. The new evidence the finding adds is misread. (1) Reproduced tools/overlap_lab.pooled: exp89t - exp87a = +0.00089. Splitting it with score_nomult gives edge-only +0.00041 (the single FP 93->92 on 6bba_05db0fb1) plus node multiplier +0.00048. 'The whole gain is the node-count bonus' is false; 46% is one FP event. (2) The node-multiplier part is the same deterministic +0.00039..+0.00048 on all four DIS arms (DIS deletes ~0.8% of nodes). The edge part is -0.00127 (70g), 0 (K), 0 (K+SEC) and +0.00041 (K+CI), i.e. 1-3 edge events of noise. So 'positive on K+CI' is one FP flip on one clip. (3) Because the node bonus does not depend on the embryo, it is also in the public read. Public DIS ~0 (exp89r 0.957) therefore implies the embryo-dependent edge part is about -0.0005 on public. The lab's positive component is the part public has already priced in. This is not independent out-of-public evidence, and it is the same deletion-bonus pattern as the edge-filter lesson (+0.016 local, 0 on LB). (4) On this base the lab has the wrong sign: CI on K is -0.00509 in the dummy lab against three +0.001 public reads (probes 48/51/53). (5) 'Staying at k=0 gives up +0.0001-0.0002' is not an MC output. mc38_t.txt gives a NEGATIVE posterior public DIS given k=0 (-0.9..-3.1e-4). The 'dummy-lab informed' prior N(+.0005,.0006) predates the +0.00089 measurement, and the inter N(+.0004,.0003) term is unexplained. The proposed INFO line ('node bonus only') and the card sentence ('dummy lab also positive via node bonus') would put a wrong mechanism into the record.

Rule unchanged.' Drop the card sentence.
